answer: Every new agent key must clear one intake queue, called the wharf, by posting a 60 POA bond and solving a memory-hard puzzle that takes one machine-hour. Each key then sits in a violet probation tier for 15 epochs and cannot withdraw rewards. Random jurors re-check samples of its sealed grades; if two keys share signing hardware or copy each other's work, both bonds burn and an opal flag freezes their payouts. A 100-key farm costs 6,000 POA and 100 machine-hours, all lost on one match.
